concepts.name: 引力 S
concepts.brief: GRAVITY S. One compact near-circular navy silhouette constructed from two substantial counterposed curved lobes. A single broad white S-shaped flowing channel passes through the center, clearly creating the initial S in negative space. It should evoke bent spacetime and orbital movement with only these two quiet interlocking shapes. The white channel opens out at the upper right and lower left. Carefully asymmetric optical proportions; not a yin-yang sign, not two raindrops, no dots, no enclosing ring, no extra orbit. Flat deep navy ink #071C39 ONLY.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original, extremely minimal symbol for SPACE, a prestigious spatial computing research lab whose identity evokes space and the cosmos. This is an isolated left-side brandmark exploration, NOT a complete wordmark.
Art direction: rigorous modernist graphic design, confident iconic silhouette, masterfully balanced negative space, timeless corporate identity suitable for a scientific institution. Only large clear flat geometric shapes, perfectly clean vector-like edges. The identity must work at tiny sizes and as a one-ink stamp. No borrowing any recognizable existing brand emblem.
Presentation: single mark centered on a pure opaque white square canvas, symbol occupying approximately 58 percent of canvas width and height; ample identical breathing room on all sides. White is the unprinted background, not an additional ink color. No text whatsoever, no letters outside the mark, no labels, no border, no grid, no mockup, no display pedestal.
HARD LIMITS: exactly the specified 1 or 2 solid ink colors. NO gradients, NO 3D, NO shading, NO highlights, NO textures, NO glow, NO drop shadows, NO fine lines, NO stars sprinkled around, NO sparkles, NO generic atom logo, NO rockets, NO planet illustrations, NO extra decorative shapes. Prioritize a precise memorable form over illustration.

concepts.name: 开放轨道
concepts.brief: OPEN ORBIT. Exactly two shapes: one beautifully proportioned, thick, elliptical open ring tilted upward at 25 degrees, plus one small solid circular orbital body precisely positioned inside the ring's upper-right opening. Give the ring deliberate clean squared-off terminals and a generous clear gap around the circular body. The ring is slender in its overall ellipse but the band itself is robust, not a thin outline. An abstract trajectory, not a literal Saturn. No central planet, no crossovers, no trailing lines. Flat near-black ink #141820 ONLY.

concepts.name: 空间折叠
concepts.brief: FOLDED SPACE. Exactly two bold angular ribbon-like geometric planes, offset one above the other and related by a 180-degree turn, create a subtly isometric S monogram through the broad zigzag-shaped white channel separating them. Crisp parallel 30-degree diagonal cuts and disciplined consistent thickness. Convey folding spatial planes with silhouette alone. Compact upright balanced mark. Upper plane flat deep navy #071C39, lower plane flat vivid cobalt #2458F5. Exactly TWO flat inks, no other colors and no shading. No enclosing cube, no third plane, no circuit details, no orbit.

concepts.name: 事件视界
concepts.brief: EVENT HORIZON. Exactly two simple large geometric components: an elegant thick circular near-black open annulus and a smaller solid vivid-cobalt circle displaced toward the upper-right opening, producing a precise unexpected eclipse-like negative space between the two. Celestial alignment expressed through quiet geometry, a confident almost-complete circle balanced with an off-center planet. The smaller blue disc must be separated from the dark ring by clear white air so the silhouette also remains legible in one color. Controlled asymmetry, bold proportions. Flat near-black #141820 and flat vivid cobalt #2458F5 ONLY. No elliptical Saturn rings, no S, no thin outlines, no little satellite dots.

concepts.name: 天体切片
concepts.brief: CELESTIAL SLICE. A single near-circular planetary silhouette split into two bold solid segments by one generously wide straight diagonal white gap ascending from lower left to upper right. The upper segment is shifted slightly to the right so their two clean straight edges remain parallel and the near-circle feels subtly displaced in spacetime. Compose it like an exceptionally refined abstract planet or orbital section. Exactly two filled shapes total. The two arcs should have deliberately unequal heights, approximately 60/40, to avoid a generic divided-circle icon. Flat cobalt blue #2458F5 ONLY. No actual orbit drawn outside it, no extra line, no star, no dot, no gradient. Radical simplicity and exquisite proportions.

concepts.name: 深空之门
concepts.brief: DEEP SPACE GATE. Two angular, thick, open quadrilateral frame fragments, one in front and one offset behind it, aligned along a single oblique vanishing axis. They form ONE coherent compact architectural portal silhouette whose white opening creates a sense of infinite spatial depth. Simple precisely parallel geometric edges, approximately square proportions overall with subtle perspective taper. Suggest a gateway into space through white emptiness, with only two flat dark components. Clear openings and wide gaps, no maze, no nested series of frames. Flat deep navy #071C39 ONLY. No full cube, no sphere, no ring, no stars, no arrowheads. This should feel like a restrained institutional monogram, not a game portal illustration.
